package.description: Monitor and control network ports on Windows

en-US.description: Monitor and control network ports on Windows
en-US.longDescription: A glass, Apple-style Windows desktop app to see every open TCP/UDP port, which process owns it, and kill processes right from the UI. Includes live auto-refresh, search and filters, process details, watched ports with toast notifications, and a system tray with a quick glance of listening ports.
en-US.name: Ports Controller
